title: Jagged Creamy Slovakian Danmuji Bake
description: A comforting, savory, and creamy vegan-friendly Slovakian dish featuring brine-dried danmuji. It's a perfect breakfast or brunch option for a cozy morning

ingredients.name: Non-dairy milk (such as soy or almond milk)

instructions: Grease a 9x9-inch baking dish with grapeseed oil.
Mix the danmuji, non-dairy milk, and vegan butter or margarine in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until combined.
Stir in the chopped parsley, nutritional yeast, and cashew cream.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the edges are set.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped scallions.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
